_note: How a deal is scored 0-100. Edit the weights (they should add up to 100) and the thresholds, then redeploy: every card, the PDF and Home pick it up. Reworked 2026-11-01 (the owner): the grade is mostly how far the price WE would pay (our bid) sits from the price THEY ask - an ask can be negotiated, so a deal is not an F for its asking price alone. With no ask, the reference is the price the income supports at our 5.5% cap. The return factors judge the financials at that price.

timing._note: How soon the IRR target is hit: the earliest plain sale year that clears it. Needing a refinance or a year-8 exit means more money, more work and more time, so it scores less.

price._note: Our bid against their price: full points when we can pay what they ask, none when our bid is overpayForZero (30%) or more below it. headroomForFull stays 0: paying more than they ask is not rewarded.

risk._note: Occupancy (a stabilised building) and how many of the model's own checks still need an input.
